title: Chapter 1013
text:
The records clearly recorded the major achievements of the Black Star Corps before the version update twenty years ago. Mad Blade set up a search window and filtered out the achievements of the army from Year 709 to Year 729 in the Galaxy Calendar.

The first thing he saw was a line of bold records.

Galaxy Calendar Year 710, Black Star became a Mechanical Deity!

This term instantly caused a huge impact on Mad Blade's young mind. There was only one thought left in his mind, and that was that Black Star had become a god!

Mad Blade calmed himself down, checked the information, and realized that the Mechanical Deity did not mean 'God' but the name of a Divine Throne Mechanic. This meant that Black Star had already become a pinnacle Beyond Grade A Super.

"That scared me. I thought that Old Black was about to ascend."

Mad Blade heaved a sigh of relief and could not wait to continue reading. He realized that a few major events had happened in the same year.

First, the end of the first exploration phase. The army obtained the first batch of seven Star Systems and became the largest armed organization in the Flickering World. The Germinal Financial Group was established and became the subsidiary financial organization of the army. They started a business war with the Limitless Financial Group in many areas. The Super Academy Plan was implemented, and the Black Star Corps had already established tens of thousands of Super Academies in the Shattered Star Ring, grooming countless Supers. A considerable number of them chose to become members of the army.

At the same time, after Black Star became a Mechanical Deity, he fought with the Tyrant again and defeated him with just one avatar, establishing his position as the strongest person in the Shattered Star Ring. Not long after, the Mecha Empire invaded, and a conflict broke out between the two sides. In the end, the dynasty came to the rescue of the Mecha Empire and forced them to retreat.

Just by looking at the records, Mad Blade could feel the turbulence of that period.

This period of time seemed to be the watershed of the army's activities. After that, the army entered a stable period of low-key development. Black Star withdrew from the list of strong contenders and quietly farmed in the Flickering World. This lasted until Year 716, when the Kunde Race war broke out. This was the first quasi Star Cluster level native civilization to be destroyed.

However, there were very few records of this period of history, and there was only a rough summary. The only valuable clue that Mad Blade obtained was that the Black Star Corps was now in charge of the Kunde Race's transformation, and this mission had already lasted for thirteen years.

After the war with the Kunde Race, the army maintained its dormant development style during the second and third exploration phases. It was only recently that they showed their prowess once again. The army welcomed its second Beyond Grade A, and it was surprisingly someone he was familiar with.

"Hella has reached the Beyond Grade A Super?" When Mad Blade saw the name, his eyes widened in shock.

None of the players who were born in Blue Star were unfamiliar with Hella. Be it the villain 'Crimson Snake' in Version 1.0 or the one who fought side by side with her during the Mutation Disaster in Version 2.0, her image was deeply imprinted in the minds of all the old Blue Star players. The main reason was because of Hella's stunning appearance.

All the old players knew about the grudges between Black Star and Hella, which had been entangled from Blue Star all the way to the universe. She was also an old friend who had appeared a long time ago.

Mad Blade had spent four versions of effort for the army, and the army was already his faction in his heart. Now that his faction had a new backer, Mad Blade was pleasantly surprised.

Suppressing his excitement, Mad Blade flipped to the end of the resume. The most recent major event was the 'Meeting of the Gods' held by Black Star, which gathered seventy to eighty Beyond Grade As together.

Seeing the terrifying influence Black Star had, his heart skipped a beat, and he was so shocked that he almost forgot to breathe. After twenty years, Black Star's position in the universe had already reached such a level!

"Oh my god …"

Before Frenzied Sword could recover from his shock, a burst of loud laughter suddenly rang out beside him, scaring him out of his wits.

"Wahahaha! This feels good! "

Pork Bun placed his hands on his waist and laughed out loud. His mouth was so wide that it looked like it was about to split open. His smile was like that of a vicious dog.

"What are you laughing at?" Mad Blade covered his ears with a confused expression.

"Look, in the twenty years since the version update, how much history has Black Star accumulated? It's all video material. This is a treasure!"

Pork Bun was overjoyed. With so much material, he did not have to worry about not having anything to do.

He was prepared to record all the deeds of the army during the update period to help the army players understand the history of the army. Just thinking about it, he knew that it would definitely be a selling point.

Thinking of this, Bun-Hit-Dog glanced around and realized that many people were holding onto their communicators to check the army's resume. He could not help but open up the forums and display his ability as the number one paparazzi. He posted the army's resume that he had simply sorted out and gave it an eye-catching title — "Shocking! Twenty Years of the Army! "

With the opening of the new version, countless players were excitedly exchanging information on the forums. As soon as the post was posted, it attracted a lot of attention in the Shattered Star Ring.

Army Commander's Big PP: "I'm impressed. Old Black is really amazing!"

Alchemist: "Old Black has lasted from the first version until now. He's a legend that started from scratch. Is there anyone else in the universe who is more amazing than him?"

Silly Cat: "The ID of the brother above really makes one's imagination run wild …"

Magnetic Link: "I didn't expect Hella to also become a Beyond Grade A Super. Speaking of which, do you still remember Black Star's background? He was a traitor of the Germinal Organization, and Hella was also a member of the Germinal Organization … Tsk, this is scary!"

Causeway Bay's Situ Haonan: "Two Beyond Grade As popped up from an organization on a small planet. Black Star is indeed a universe-level protagonist type character! "

Mysterious Man: "The Germinal Organization is not dead. It's just hibernating!"

Mad Blade was engrossed in the forums when he was suddenly dragged to the dock by Maple Moon.

"Stop looking. Let's go to the Flickering World as soon as possible."

With someone taking the lead, all the players in the Black Star Corps headquarters moved and swarmed to the dock like a tide.

…

The forums, which had been silent for a long time, became extremely lively. After the scattered army players understood the situation of the version, they immediately headed to the nearest army base and boarded the fleet to the Flickering World. No one was willing to miss the World Server.

As a member of the Black Star Corps, since they had such a huge advantage, they could not waste it.

In the eyes of the professional clubs, the fact that the Chinese players in the Shattered Star Ring had such a huge faction advantage was simply asking for their lives. The various guilds hurriedly held private meetings to discuss.

"The situation is not good. The Main Storyline of this version is too advantageous for the Chinese players. The World Server is right next to the Shattered Star Ring, and they even went there in advance. Our guilds have entered the World Server, so it will be very difficult for us to compete with the top Chinese guilds like Dynasty and Long Sky. We will definitely be at a disadvantage in a guild war, which might affect the growth of our professional players. "

"Three of the top four spots in the previous version were taken by the Chinese. This time, we can't let them continue to dominate."

"This is troublesome. The Black Star Corps is the local tyrant in the World Server and is the backer of the Chinese players. Do we have to turn around and join the Black Star Corps?"

"The professional players and the main force of the guild can only go to the higher faction. It will be very difficult for them to switch to another faction. Otherwise, their efforts in the previous versions will be wasted."

"That's right. Even if we switch factions, we won't be able to compete with the accumulation of the Chinese players in the Black Star Corps."

"Let's observe the situation first and see how the Chinese guilds respond. If it's not ideal … we might have to unite the clubs of the other countries."

Although it was only the first day of the new version, the opening of the World Server made the clubs of the various Star Fields unable to sit still.

There was no helping it. The faction advantage of the Chinese players was just too great. The strong teams like America, France, Korea, and Japan all had thoughts of forming an alliance.

…

"All the players have moved …"

After hearing Philip's report, Han Xiao secretly smiled.

With the opening of the Flickering World and the expansion of the explored universe, the flow of people in this Star Field had skyrocketed. There were vacancies everywhere, and opportunities were everywhere. The advantage that the Black Star Corps had accumulated for so long could finally be put to good use.

To him, this was not the exploration stage but the harvest stage!

With a territory, it was like sitting on a fishing platform. The outsiders would continuously bring him benefits, and he had turned from a chess piece to a chess player. The profits of the ruling class were incomparable.

With countless organizations competing here, the players would have a huge amount of mission resources, countless channels to obtain experience, and many opportunities to fight.

However, the new version has just opened. It won't be so easy to harvest experience, Han Xiao thought to himself.

The main goal of the players now was to continue leveling up. Most of the experience earned would be invested into leveling up. These were all seedlings that still needed to be fertilized. It was not time for him to harvest them on a large scale.

If he wanted to level up quickly, he would have to wait for the players to accumulate experience for a while.

However, Han Xiao was not in a hurry. The army's store had added many new things. No matter how stingy the players were, he could make them willingly pay. The efficiency of accumulating experience was much higher than doing it alone.

His level, which had been stagnant for a long time, could finally rise quickly!

The players from various countries flooding into the world server was the best time to expand his leek farm. Now that the Black Star Corps attracted foreign players, Han Xiao no longer needed to do much. The advantages and reputation accumulated over the past few versions were the core attraction.

The greater the advantage that the army players had in the Flickering World, the greater the attraction of the Black Star Corps. However, it was precisely because the advantage was too great that Han Xiao guessed that some of the foreign clubs might work together to fight against the Chinese players. Therefore, helping the army players was imperative.

In his previous life, in Version 4.0, clubs from various countries constantly formed alliances and betrayed each other. Things like making distant friends and attacking those close to them, forming alliances, besieging Wei to rescue Zhao, and attacking Guo under false pretenses. It felt like the Warring States Period.

According to his plan, in Version 4.0, he would use the army's territory as his base and provide resources to help the army players develop. At the same time, he would use the strength of the players to cause trouble, attack the opponents, protect his own organization, and absorb more players to satisfy his leveling needs.

"Modo Civilization, Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …" Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

The players had just come online, and it would take some time for the players of the various Star Fields to all come to the Flickering World. Apart from the players, these two matters were the most important for him to deal with.

The Kunde Race's mission required him to take revenge on the Modo Civilization. Back then, the dynasty had told him to wait until the Flickering World opened up before fully implementing the plan. Now, the Modo Civilization's troops had also entered the Flickering World. On his home ground, Han Xiao had a hundred ways to make the Modo Civilization unable to survive.

The mission reward was the [Proof of Leadership] talent, which was very useful to the leader of a large organization like himself. Han Xiao had waited for more than ten years, and now, he could finally make his move.

Furthermore, the time for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy to appear was almost here. There would probably be many organizations fighting over it. Han Xiao had already sent troops to the coordinates marked by EsGod's legacy.

He had made two preparations and specifically looked up the host in his previous life. If his memory served him right, it should be an ordinary person named Evans. Now, he had already grasped Evans' location. He was also in the Flickering World and was under his surveillance.

If no one under him could control the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, he would pull out the host in his previous life, and it would definitely work.

While thinking, Han Xiao asked Philip, "Find out where the Modo Civilization is.

"Find out where the Modo Civilization's fleet is … I'll give them a 'big gift' first."

—
